To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

people who have been trafficked experience a thwarted sense and agency to pursue their personal goals in the present, and that this leads to a feeling of ‘in limbo’, which in turn makes it more difficult for them to deal with the problems related to their futures.
the recovery experience of people in this programme was characterized by their thwarted journey towards a goal pursuit.

the recovery experience of people trafficked for sexual exploitation can be described as a ‘thwarted journey toward goal pursuit’ in a ‘limbo-like’ situation, in which the experience of being thwarted in their pursuit of goals and the lack of autonomy in redressing their situation, together with their ostracized position in Dutch society, make it difficult for them to cope with problems related to the past and the future.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the recovery experience of people with a history of being sex trafficked.
the recovery process of trafficked people and the role of goal attainment in this process.
the importance of hope, goal pursuit, goal attainment and a strengths-based approach in the process of recovery from the trauma of trafficking.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
a person’s goal pursuit and goal attainment can be a key element in the recovery process after sex trafficking.
a strengths-based approach, in which service users’ personal goals are central, can help to facilitate the recovery of people who are sex trafficked.
‘The recovery process of service users who were sex trafficted is a journey towards goal pursuit, in the midst of the thwarting of their agency to attain their goals’.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we need to provide opportunities to hope for a positive future and pursue and attain one’s goals.
we need to provide opportunities for people to hope for, to pursue and to attain their personal goals, within the structural boundaries they are faced with.
it is important to provide people with opportunities to hope and to pursue their goals.
The main takeaway from our work is that
it is not enough to offer a shelter and services for people who have been trafficked; we need to help them to move towards their goals and envision a future that is meaningful to them.
service users in post-trafficking programmes are able to find ways to pursue their goals, despite the structural and personal limitations they experience.

it is crucial to provide opportunities for people who were trafficked for the purposes of sexual exploitation to realize their own future goals, as this helps them to cope with past problems and to deal with their worries about the present.
